subject: Evaluation milestone appears delayed
description: The technical evaluation was expected to start by 5 September 2026 as per the published timeline, but as of 8 September no update has been published. Requesting a status update.
internal_notes: Delay due to additional document verification. Will update public timeline.

subject: Transparent Procurement Process Appreciated
description: I appreciate the initiative to publish evaluation criteria and document requirements publicly. The use of AI for compliance checking is a great step towards eliminating manual bias in procurement decisions.

subject: MSME Vendor Preference Not Adequately Specified
description: The tender document does not clearly explain the MSME preference criteria applicable under the Government procurement policy. Small and medium enterprises from Tier 2 cities are at a disadvantage. Request clarification on the preference percentage and eligibility.

subject: Evaluation Timeline Significantly Behind Schedule
description: The bid evaluation was originally scheduled to conclude by 15 September 2026 but has not progressed. Industries waiting for contract award are facing uncertainty. The procurement authority should publish a revised timeline with clear milestones.

subject: Query on Financial Bid Opening Procedure
description: Could the procurement authority clarify the procedure for financial bid opening? Will there be a public notification before financial bids are opened? Citizens and industry stakeholders would benefit from attending or at least receiving timely updates.

subject: Technical Specifications Too Complex for Smaller Vendors
description: The technical requirements for OEM authorization and ISO certifications effectively exclude smaller innovative companies from participating. The procurement process should consider allowing startups with demonstrated capability but without all legacy certifications.

subject: GEM Portal Integration Works Well
description: The integration with the GEM portal has made the submission process straightforward. Document upload and tracking features are working well. Suggestion: add email notifications for status changes so bidders do not need to keep checking the portal.
